This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Biology and appearance==
This humanoid sentient species was distinguished by their low-set eyes and distinct coloration,<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> being either solid red<ref name="The Mandalorian">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}</ref> or splotchy red and white.<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Daiyu-Kenobi.png|thumb|left|250px|A member of this species hanging around the streets of Daiyu City]]
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> in [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|II}}</ref> a member of this species could be found hanging around the streets of [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> At least two other members of this species was present on the [[city]] planet [[Coruscant]] around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|19}}</ref> specifically while ex-[[Galactic Empire|Imperials]] [[Penn Pershing]] and [[Elia Kane]] attempted to [[Mission to retrieve the mobile lab station|retrieve Pershing's mobile lab station]].<ref name="The Mandalorian" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the limited television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']],<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> which was released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref>
